description: FIND-2-001 boundary-fix is INCOMPLETE. REQ-Q2 at line 209-212 was rewritten to the half-open convention (FULL iff b>=3.0; MEDIUM iff 1.0<=b<3.0; LIGHT iff 0.1<=b<1.0; MINIMAL iff b<0.1). But REQ-P1 at line 67-68 was NOT updated and STILL uses the old informal range syntax: 'FULL (remaining% per pass > 3%) / MEDIUM (1-3%) / LIGHT (< 1%) / MINIMAL (0% remaining)'. The contradictions: (1) at b=3.0, REQ-Q2 says FULL but REQ-P1 says MEDIUM (since 3 is in the closed '1-3' range AND fails '> 3'); (2) at b=1.0, REQ-Q2 says MEDIUM but REQ-P1's '1-3' is ambiguous about lower boundary; (3) REQ-P1's 'MINIMAL (0% remaining)' is exclusive equality with 0 while REQ-Q2's MINIMAL covers b<0.1 inclusive of all values below 0.1. The manifest's extraConstraint explicitly required 'grep REQ-Q2 + REQ-Q5 + REQ-B5 references; all should use the same half-open convention.' REQ-P1 is the introductory REQ that names the budgets the rest of the spec consumes — leaving it on the old wording means PROP-P1-budget-quantize will pass against REQ-Q2 but fail against REQ-P1 at the b=3.0 fixture. FIND-2-001 must be closed at REQ-P1 as well, not just at REQ-Q2.
